body:
Track 2, milestone 1 (`ambient-pipeline`). Streaming Silero VAD, Whisper tiny.en, Qwen2.5-0.5B and Piper on four CPU cores over synthetic speech; per-stage latency, RTF and memory and a reply-latency budget (0.94–1.55 s at 200–800 ms hangover). Stylised: synthetic audio, server CPU, no real-device claims. 7 unit tests; `python site/build.py` prints ok. Piper's pip wheel is GPL-3.0 and is used only as an unbundled dependency; the README says so.
